hotels.title: Private Bali Villa with Three Bedrooms and a Rooftop Lounge
hotels.description: Nakula’s Fenta Villa is a private three-bedroom retreat in Canggu, where Balinese character meets a relaxed indoor-outdoor way of living. Step through the traditional entrance into a sunlit villa centred around a private pool, with three ensuite bedrooms, open-plan spaces for gathering, a billiards corner and a rooftop terrace made for lingering over dinner as the sky changes colour. Outside your private hideaway are Canggu’s best-known beach clubs, cafes and coastline are within easy reach, including Finns Beach Club, Milk & Madu Café and Berawa Beach. Return to the villa between outings to cool off in the pool, gather over dinner or enjoy a quiet drink on the rooftop terrace.

hotels.title: Badung Bali Villa with Private Pool & Cabana Near Pererenan Beach
hotels.description: Pererenan’s laid-back beach scene is at your doorstep at Villa Xanadu, where vaulted timber ceilings, woven textures and open-air living bring Bali’s easy rhythm indoors. A private pool sits at the heart of the villa, framed by loungers and shaded seating for slow afternoons between swims. Gather around the dining area, cook in the fully equipped kitchen and take your pick of two living spaces - one open to the tropical breeze, the other upstairs for quieter moments. The villa’s setting puts Pererenan Beach, La Brisa and Canggu’s cafe scene within reach, while daily breakfast lets you start each morning without leaving your hideaway

hotels.title: Private-Pool Villas amid Tropical Gardens near Canggu
hotels.description: Slow down in a private villa framed by tropical gardens, where mornings begin with breakfast in your own space and afternoons unfold by the pool. Bumbak Park Villas pairs generous indoor-outdoor living with fully equipped kitchens, serene garden outlooks and your own swimming pool. Share unhurried days with family or friends, arrange an in-villa spa treatment, or head out to discover the cafes, restaurants and beach clubs of nearby Canggu and Seminyak. Batu Belig Beach is approximately a 20-minute walk away, while daily housekeeping and attentive service give you a tidy villa to return to.
